description:
Exceptional Two-Bedroom Duplex Apartment with Marina Views and Two Private Balconies

Situated within the highly sought-after Ocean Village Marina development, this stunning two-bedroom duplex apartment offers an enviable waterfront lifestyle with two private balconies enjoying beautiful far-reaching views across the marina and surrounding waters.

For those seeking luxury waterside living combined with the convenience of renowned restaurants, stylish bars, cafés, and everyday amenities just moments from their doorstep, this impressive home is not to be missed.

Accessed via a secure entry system and benefitting from a seven-day concierge service, the apartment is located on the fourth floor and served by lift access. Its elevated position allows for spectacular views across the marina, creating a truly special setting.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hall which also provides an ideal area for a home office or study space. An attractive turning staircase leads to the first floor, while the entrance level also offers a convenient cloakroom/WC and utility room.

The heart of the home is the superb open-plan living space, where the lounge, dining area, and contemporary kitchen seamlessly combine to create an exceptional entertaining and relaxation area. Large panoramic picture windows flood the room with natural light while perfectly framing the stunning marina views. The modern kitchen is beautifully appointed and well-equipped, complementing the stylish living environment.

From the living area, doors open onto a generously proportioned balcony, providing the perfect place to enjoy a morning coffee or evening drink while overlooking the vibrant marina below and taking in the far-reaching waterside views.

The first-floor landing benefits from a useful storage cupboard and provides access to two spacious double bedrooms, both featuring their own en-suite facilities. The principal bedroom further enjoys direct access to a second sizeable balcony, offering another private outdoor space from which to appreciate the exceptional setting.

The duplex layout creates a far more homely, flexible, and individual feel than many modern apartments, providing a unique living experience rarely found in contemporary developments.

Further benefits include a secure allocated parking space, accessible via lift and staircase.

Location

Ocean Village is one of Southampton's premier waterfront destinations, offering an outstanding selection of restaurants, bars, cafés, convenience stores, and leisure facilities. The vibrant Oxford Street dining quarter is nearby, while Southampton city centre, Westquay Shopping Centre, cinema complex, and ferry terminals with high-speed links to the Isle of Wight are all within easy walking distance.

For boating enthusiasts, marina berths are currently available to rent directly through the marina, adding further appeal to this exceptional waterside location.

Combining style, space, quality, and an unbeatable waterfront setting, this remarkable home will appeal to professionals, downsizers, second-home purchasers, and investors alike. Offered with no onward an early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this outstanding apartment has to offer.
